gates.note: Candidate validators and semantic tests are on main, but a successful current-main CI execution is not yet recorded here.
AIOps exact-subject approval, TTL, separation-of-duties, BLOCK precedence and bounded emergency semantics are represented by the candidate contracts and tests.
ERP4 provides negative-test and release-gate source evidence, but a project-side consumer of this Security policy model is not yet bound.
At least one non-AIOps project must consume the authz/approval contracts with revision-bound proof.
The core contract forbids embedded sensitive values, but a consumer-side redaction test is still required.
Branch/check enforcement is a repository control and must be observed externally before canonical promotion.
Promotion remains blocked until the canonical owner explicitly authorizes it after the technical gates pass.
